thread: Maya (Product): Hey team — quick design review request for the first-run "lift strip" that appears at the top of the Console when a new workspace is created. Screenshot + prototype: https://img.mock/console-liftstrip-2145.png. Two quick asks: CTA microcopy, and accessibility/keyboard flow checks. Can we get takeaways by EOD? Sam (Design): Saw it — nice lightweight pattern. Thoughts: make the primary CTA more specific. Right now it says `Get started` which feels generic. Options: `Create a sample project` or `Run quickstart`. Leaning toward `Create sample project` since it maps to the product action. Also thinking the strip should be dismissible but persistent for 24h, not sticky forever. Junie (Accessibility): Quick a11y notes from prototype: contrast of the lighter CTA (#6B7BA4 on white) fails WCAG AA for small text. Also tab order jumps from global nav into a collapsed menu before the strip CTA — feels like a focus trap for keyboard users. Suggest: primary CTA color #0B63D6 (meets 4.5:1), secondary text color #334155, and add an initial `Skip tour` link as the first tabbable element. Eli (Frontend): Implementation notes: making the strip tabbable + not trap focus is doable but we need to ensure the strip doesn't intercept global keyboard shortcuts. I'll prototype using `aria-roledescription="onboarding strip"` and a visually-hidden skip link. Example for CTA: ```html Create sample project ``` Also we should prefer `role="region"` plus `aria-labelledby` for the strip so screen readers can jump. Sam (Design): Good call on the `aria-roledescription`. For copy variants: A) `Create sample project` B) `Start guided quickstart` C) `Explore sample apps` — I'd test A vs B. A feels more action-oriented, B signals a guided flow. Maya (Product): Agree on A vs B experiment. Success metric: `onboarding_sample_project_created` within 7 days and `first_run_dismissed` rate. Can devs do a gated rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%)? Eli (Frontend): Yep. We can gate via feature flag + rollout config. I'll add analytics events: `onboard_strip_cta_click`, `onboard_strip_dismiss`, `onboard_strip_auto_hide`. Also will include `variant = A|B` in payload. Junie (Accessibility): Additional nit: sample project thumbnails need `alt` text (not just decorative) — e.g., `alt="Todo sample app: minimal chat UI"`. And captions should have at least 16px accessible sizing or allow zoom. Also ensure focus-visible outlines are preserved — don't remove them in CSS. Sam (Design): Visual tweak: reduce strip height by 8px, tighten left padding, and swap the secondary link from muted gray to a slightly warmer neutral so it reads as clickable on hover. I'll update the Figma and add token values. DeployBot: New build deployed to staging (build #4572) — includes initial liftstrip markup and variant A copy. Eli (Frontend): Pushed draft PR (#862) with the focus/aria changes and color adjustments: https://git.mock/r/redwood/console/pull/862. Needs design review on spacing and Junie's sign-off on a11y. Maya (Product): Great — can everyone leave final comments in the PR by 5pm? If Junie signs off, we'll schedule canary rollout tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
